tagline: 美能达胶片单反相机，1996 年发布
description: 美能达于1996年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度30 sec. downto 1/2000 sec., with flash 1/125 sec. or slower。使用Advanced Photo System。感光度available films had 100 to 800 ASA (100 to 400 ASA still available)。CCD-based phase-detecting TTL autofocus。

specs.感光度: available films had 100 to 800 ASA (100 to 400 ASA still available)
specs.曝光测光: TTL with 14 field measuring photo diode, spontaneously switchable to spot metering (button), second 4 field photo diode for TTL flash metering
specs.快门速度: 30 sec. downto 1/2000 sec., with flash 1/125 sec. or slower
specs.闪光灯: guide number 14, also used as autofocus support light
